name: Camp Chinqueka
description_short: Camp Chinqueka is an overnight summer camp for girls ages 7 to 16 in Bantam, Connecticut, with sessions from one week (Rookie) to a full eight-week season between June 27 and August 21, 2027. Activities range from waterskiing, sailing and climbing to dance, ceramics and horseback riding. Tuition includes meals, snacks, laundry, towel service, gratuities, the canteen shop and all on-camp activities.
refund_policy_summary: Half of the deposit cannot be refunded under any circumstances, and the whole deposit becomes non-refundable after 12/31/26. Balances are due May 1. Unused canteen money is not refunded.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers get swim instruction from American Red Cross certified counselors, from Level 1 to Lifeguard Training, plus free swim in the camp's lake. Waterskiing, shared with Camp Awosting, is on Bantam Lake, 7 miles away.

source.title: Chinqueka Dates and Rates for This Year's Summer Camp for Girls

warnings: Session prices shown are Early Bird rates, valid until November 15, 2026. Regular rates are higher: 1 week $2,755, 2 weeks $5,360, 3 weeks $7,270, 4 weeks $9,180, 6 weeks $11,435, full season $13,230. price_min is the Early Bird 1-week rate and price_max is the regular full-season rate.

Canteen fees are charged on top of tuition ($80–$250 depending on session length). Other extras include linen and trunk rental, the senior trip, horseback riding at $80/hour, and airport transportation at $250 each way.
The camp says enrollment is usually full by the end of January.
There is a separate day camp, with prices on another page. This listing covers only the overnight camp.
Week 3 is in both the Weeks 1–3 and Weeks 3–5 three-week sessions, as listed on the source.
